limitations: Some OCR artifacts in mathematical notation.

tasks: Task 1: Develop global equity measurement model and validate
Task 2: Model asteroid mining market and determine equity impact
Task 3: Analyze impact of changing conditions on equity
Task 4: Propose policies to promote global equity

section_map.summary: Four-phase abstract with HELEN, asteroid mining market, model adjustment, policy
Background on resource depletion and asteroid mining, our work
Six assumptions including unlimited asteroid resources and economic principles
Symbol table for mining market model
Five-dimension equity index, AHP+EWM weights, validation vs Piketty
KPCA clustering, Cobb-Douglas, Cournot equilibrium, HELEN impact
Simulation with enterprise count, SEM for national power

contributions.summary: HELEN acronym: five-dimensional equity index with 16 indicators.
Cournot equilibrium with regulatory market share caps.
Simulation showing restriction lowers peak inequity but delays inflection.

dependency_graph.handoff: HELEN equity index is the evaluation framework for mining impact
AMM equilibrium is iterated in simulation with varying enterprise count

assumptions.summary: Asteroid resources are unlimited (for long-run analysis).
At any time, accessible resources are scarce.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Data from statista, Our World in Data, WID, CEIC. 2001-2020, ~180 countries.

models.summary: HELEN: 5+16 indicator equity index with AHP+EWM.
AMM: Cobb-Douglas + Cournot + regulatory caps -> HELEN impact.
ADJ: Simulation + SEM for condition changes.

verification.summary: HELEN validated against Piketty top-10% income share by region.
Sensitivity on delta_U shows same trend across values.

results_trace.summary: Regional consistency: Europe/Oceania lowest, Africa/Latin America highest.
Equilibrium shares: Leader 53.20%, Advancer 26.13%, Pursuer 15.22%, Outsider 5.16%.
Restricted peak 0.739 vs unrestricted 0.789. Inflection at 1800 vs 1200.

writing_logic.summary: HELEN acronym formed from five dimension initials — branded system.
Moon Agreement citation gives legal authority to regulatory framework.
Policy section structured as three numbered subsections with feasibility analysis.

language_observations.summary: 'It has always been a puzzle' opener makes the problem feel timeless and universal.
'We present our work as four phases' — numbered phases divide the abstract clearly.
Three rhetorical questions ('What does...? How will...? Shall we...?') engage the reader before the work summary.
HELEN acronym (Health, Environment, Life, Economy, Natural resources) is a branded five-letter name.
Leader/Advancer/Pursuer/Outsider naming hierarchy makes clustering results vivid and memorable.
'the barrier is struck, and more private companies are able to break the barrier' — metaphor for technology diffusion.
Moon Agreement citation grounds the royalty proposal in international law.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 5: Global equity index by region
Figure 6: Asteroid Mining Market Model diagram

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: HELEN acronym and five-dimension structure is an original framework for global equity.
Country clustering with named tiers makes the competitive landscape tangible.
Grounding policy in the Moon Agreement gives legal legitimacy.

weaknesses.summary: High data demand and complex calculations.
Only three of five HELEN dimensions affected by mining.

independent_extensions.summary: Model impact on all five HELEN dimensions, not just three.
Replace SEM with causal inference methods for stronger claims.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Branded multi-dimensional equity index is reusable for any F-type equity evaluation.
International treaty citation gives policy proposals legal weight.

unresolved_questions.question: Why alpha=0.3, beta=0.7 specifically? Sensitivity not tested on these.
Why only three HELEN dimensions affected? Health/Education and Environment could also change.
